objective: Explain and safely recover Matthew Henry Filipino translation failures from the 1 Kings 4:20 Android screenshot without showing unreliable machine output or modifying original English.
productionBaselineEvidence: Verified GitHub main source at 0ee57887c991d23472cdf1f9b849bce945792910. Exact installed APK native-module presence and live Android production/staging OTA identity were NOT verified from the screenshot; this fix is source-only and must not be described as released.
chosenApproach: Classify on-device ML Kit failures and expose a retry only for recoverable model/translation errors, preserving the Wi-Fi-only model policy, language normalization, original-English fallback, semantic/citation safeguards, account-specific cache, source attribution, and all AdMob/navigation/media behavior. Explicitly explain that missing native code requires a new Android APK, not a JS OTA.
selectionRationale: The existing hook discards every native/accuracy error into one unavailable state, so users cannot distinguish an outdated APK from an interrupted Wi-Fi download or quality rejection. An isolated hook/UI improvement provides actionable diagnosis without new service credentials, privacy risks, native changes, or duplicate translation providers.
alternativeApproaches: Automatically send the commentary to an external online translation API (rejected: introduces unapproved service, attribution/privacy requirements, billing and unverifiable doctrinal accuracy).
Bypass the semantic/citation safety gate and show any returned Filipino (rejected: risks misleading religious material).
Force cellular model downloads silently (rejected: potentially costly unexpected data usage).
preserveBehaviors: No changes to Bible Scripture, chapter selection, Daily Reading completion, Strong's lexicon, audio, notes, or cached original commentary.
Only successfully validated Filipino commentary is shown and cached within the current account; all other cases show authoritative English.
First model download requires Wi-Fi; no automatic cellular download or background retry loop.
No changes to AdMob loading/fill/navigation, native dependencies, Supabase, production or staging OTA release.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Translation hook and error UI are runtime-facing in the Bible reader.
preservedBehaviors: Prior cached translations, original text, network permission policy, and screen/navigation lifecycle unchanged.
No background retry, native, backend, AdMob or global state changes.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Correct misleading failure feedback in the verse-specific Matthew Henry Bible study panel.
preservedBehaviors: Bible passage provenance and semantic/citation safeguard remain authoritative.
Daily Reading, annotations, Strong's lexicon, chapter navigation, and translation attribution remain unchanged.

acceptanceChecks: Focused Node test covers classifying missing native APK, Wi-Fi model failure, unsafe translations, and retry wiring.
Run existing Matthew Henry, compact layout, source-scope and TypeScript checks.
On installed Android build verify real native module availability and 1 Kings 4:20 successful Filipino output; otherwise hold release.
Release remains DEV_ONLY_NO_OTA until staging RC and mandatory AdMob/navigation/spacing gates pass.
releaseTarget: staging-user Android runtime 1.3.2 after native-module and RC verification
